paragraphs.text:
He drums his fingers, “I have something for you. Should you go 
to the pyramid, search where the mark is.” He hands you a map
“Search on the east side. An opening must be there.” If you 
use the map, you get a bonus die for rolls required to find such 
an opening (make a journal entry about this). Go to 297.
(46, 292)
